Find again, the match list and open in your browser, one click each

The market as a probability bar with the spread, where the price was 5 minutes ago and a 10-minute price line

Dota 2 and LoL: games and kills instead of maps and rounds

Restart Dibu Poly from the Library, also without restarting DibuTinkuy

Dota 2: a respawn flashes green, a buyback flashes gold, and BB tags count buybacks
Dota 2: hero names as players know them (Doom, Timbersaw…) and a HERO column
Now a tool of the DibuTinkuy launcher: opened from the Library
Updates are handled by the launcher
Veto section with map cards and side picks
Live log with Rounds and Text tabs
Rows layout, up to three sections per row
Esports on Polymarket list in the main window
BetBoom inside Dibu Poly: one list with every Polymarket match and every live BetBoom match, marked PM, BB and GRID
Real time from Polymarket or BetBoom: Auto, Polymarket first or BetBoom first, and a click on a row's PM or BB opens that one
With BetBoom: its live score and its match and map winner odds, with a SUSPENDED mark when it stops taking bets
GRID through BetBoom's own proxy: delayed score, veto and live log as with Polymarket
The stream from BetBoom's Twitch broadcast when it has one
Sounds for every match, whatever the source: round start and end, map end, kills (bright for the left team, low for the right) and the bomb, each with its switch
When BetBoom asks for a check, its window opens for you to do it
Other tools on this PC can read the open match (score, GRID game state and veto)
For tools reading the open match: a round is live when its freezetime ends, not when GRID opens it at the start of the buy time; a timeout holds only until it ends
For tools reading the open match: GRID counts as alive while any of its feeds speaks, so a quiet bomb no longer reads as a lost feed
For tools reading the open match: a timeout ends when the round is played (freezetime over, a kill, the bomb), even if GRID never writes its end
BetBoom is opened by you: "Open BetBoom" in the list gives a normal BetBoom window; do the check there if it asks, and its live matches join the list
Hide or show the BetBoom window at any time; open a match in it and the scoreboard follows that match
The app never reloads BetBoom, never retries and stops if BetBoom refuses the window (403)
"Try the full list": every live esports match on BetBoom, one try; if BetBoom closes it, only the page's matches are read
BetBoom match: GRID, live log and stream start even when the match page was opened in the BetBoom window, after a check or after a reload by hand
BetBoom real time: the score now moves with BetBoom's partial updates (it stayed at 0:0 on the match page)
GRID live score through BetBoom: tries other forms of the address when BetBoom's proxy sends nothing, and says it in the log
Export (BetBoom match): includes what BetBoom sent for the match, to check the score
BetBoom match: the live score and the game state other tools read come from BetBoom's own game feed (~8 s), as in the Dibu Scraper; GRID through BetBoom's proxy came about 135 s late
If the page does not open BetBoom's game feed, Dibu Poly asks for the match on its own socket, as the page does

BetBoom match, as the Dibu Scraper: the GRID box (score, sides, round clock, who is alive, K/D/A since you opened it) and the live log (rounds, kills, bomb) come from BetBoom's game feed, ~8 s; GRID's widgets through BetBoom only give the veto
Auto: a Polymarket event without a GRID series (no live data) opens its BetBoom match when BetBoom is connected
The BetBoom window is a small browser: tabs, back and forward, reload and an address bar (Ctrl+T, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+L, F5, Alt+arrows); links that open a window open a tab
BetBoom opens only when you click "Open BetBoom", in front of you; the match you open in any tab is followed by the scoreboard

Choose the stream: the one Polymarket names, BetBoom's, or paste a Twitch, Kick or YouTube link for this match (when two matches got the same stream). Kept per match; links used lately are offered again
The open match's link also hands over Polymarket's winner markets, for tools that compare prices with them
